Software Engineering Intern at Acme Corp

Acme Corp is looking for a motivated Software Engineering Intern to join our team for a 3-month summer program.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain features for our web platform
- Write unit tests and documentation
- Participate in code reviews and sprint planning

Requirements:
- Currently pursuing a BS/MS in Computer Science or related field
- Proficiency in Python and JavaScript
- Experience with Git version control
- Familiarity with SQL databases
- Strong problem-solving skills

To apply, visit careers.acmecorp.com
